mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) and low monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a loss of central bank credibility in controlling inflation, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflation surprise with inadequate policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime characterized by housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 500,000 million dollars, the economy is overheating, leading to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above 140,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial output, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 260), unexpected increases in inflation lead to a flight to safety and negative equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 260, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
